Eredath, called the Jewel of Argus, was one of the most illustrious cities of Argus, the pinnacle of eredar civilization, and the most sacred of all cities. Following the destruction that befell Argus, the city of Eredath now floats above the planet, in a relatively pristine state.
Eredath serves as one of three zones on Argus and hosts the Seat of the Triumvirate dungeon.

{{RaceIcon|Voidscarred}} [[Voidscarred]] | government = Triumvirate (formerly) | rulers = None | frulers = {{Neutral}} [[Triumvirate]] *{{NPC||Velen|icon=Velen}} *{{NPC||Kil'jaeden|icon=Eredar Male}} *{{NPC||Archimonde|icon=Eredar Male}} | affiliation = [[Burning Legion]], [[Shadowguard]], [[Argussian Reach]], [[Army of the Light]] | loc = Floating on [[Argus]] | territory = Contested | status = In ruins }} '''Eredath''',[[A Floating Ruin]] called the Jewel of Argus,[[Maatparm]] was one of the most illustrious cities of [[Argus]],[[The Purple Hills of Eredath]] the pinnacle of [[eredar]] civilization, and the most sacred of all cities.[[Maatparm]] Following the destruction that befell Argus, the city of Eredath now floats above the planet, in a relatively pristine state.[[The Longest Vigil]] Eredath serves as one of three zones on Argus and hosts the [[Seat of the Triumvirate (instance)|Seat of the Triumvirate]] dungeon. ==Background== [[File:Mac'Aree.jpg|thumb|Eredath, the Jewel of Argus.]] [[File:Argus screen 01.jpg|thumb|The Seat of the Triumvirate.]] Eredath's hills were purple, and its rivers glittered even in complete darkness. The city's walkways were lined with precious minerals. [[Maatparm]] couldn't remember anymore how long it had been since he last was there. The [[eredar]] prior to their corruption by [[Sargeras]] seemed to have a great love and reverence for Eredath, as expressed on the inscription at the bottom of [[:The Last Relic of Argus]], "''I long for Eredath''". ===Legion=== {{Legion-section}} {{Stub-section}} The city is mostly intact compared to the rest of the world, though the land to the northwest has curved upwards, slanting the city. Having somewhat been thrown into orbit and floating above the massive scar in the planet, Eredath has mostly escaped corruption and was seemingly abandoned. But the [[Armies of Legionfall]] retrieving the [[:Sigil of Awakening]] alerted the [[Burning Legion]] who sent an assault force to Eredath in order to halt their progress.[[We Have a Problem]] ==Geography== The city core of Eredath is a floating island above the rest of the planet Argus. Eredath is dominated by the [[Seat of the Triumvirate]] to the northwest, near a huge rock wall caused by the deformation of the planet's surface. Zone Name || Faction || Level Range || Direction || Access |- | [[Krokuun]] || {{Neutral}} || 110 || South-East || By [[Lightforged beacon]] or the [[Vindicaar]]. |- | [[Antoran Wastes]] || {{Neutral}} || 110 || South-West || By [[Lightforged beacon]] or the [[Vindicaar]]. |} ==Quests== [[File:Mac'Aree triumvirate statues.jpg|thumb|The statues of the [[Triumvirate]] in front of the Seat.]] {{Main|Eredath storyline}} ==Resources== *[[Cloth]] **[[Lightweave Cloth]] *[[Herbalism]] **[[Astral Glory]] *[[Skinning]] **[[Fiendish Leather]] *[[Mining]] **[[Empyrium]] *[[Fishing]] **Junk **[[Pond Nettle]] ==Wild creatures== *{{RaceIcon|Panthara}} [[Panthara]] *{{RaceIcon|Talbuk3}} [[Talbuk]]s *{{RaceIcon|Marsuul}} [[Marsuul]]s *{{RaceIcon|WarpStalker}} [[Warp stalker]]s *{{RaceIcon|ManaRay}} [[Mana ray]]s *{{RaceIcon|Moth}} [[Moth]]s *{{RaceIcon|ManaWyrm}} [[Mana wyrm]]s *{{RaceIcon|SeaSerpent}} [[Sea serpent]] ==Notes and trivia== [[File:Krokuun orbit.jpg|thumb|The glow of the ''Xenedar'' near the rift.]] *When jumping out of the edge of the map, the player enters the "[[Twisting Nether]]" subzone shortly before dying, similar to how leaving an [[Outland]] zone does. *Eredath can be seen in the sky from [[Krokuun]]. Likewise, the glow of the ''[[Xenedar]]'' in Krokuun can be seen on the surface from Eredath. * This zone was originally named '''Mac'Aree'''. The name first appeared during ''[[World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade|The Burning Crusade]]'' with the character [[Jessera of Mac'Aree]] (now [[Maatparm]]), referencing Blizzard Lead Level Designer [[Jesse McCree]]. Both the zone and the character were renamed and [[retcon]]ned in [[patch 9.1.5]] after McCree was fired from Blizzard. *At the time, quest designer [[Jennifer Klasing]], disliked the fact that the city was indirectly named after a developer and therefore asked the voice actors to pronounce the name as "Muh-KAH-Ree".{{Ref web|url=https://twitter.com/CallMeQuestifer/status/1430982519348891650|title=Jennifer Klasing on Twitter|date=2021-08-26|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210826204104/https://twitter.com/CallMeQuestifer/status/1430982519348891650|archivedate=2021-08-26|quote=''Yeah I asked all of our VO for the zone to pronounce is Muh-KAH-Ree, because it was kinda silly that the capital city of Argus was named after that dev.''}} ==Speculation== {{Speculation}} While [[Archmage Y'mera]] does not know why the spirits of eredar linger in Eredath,[[Peer Review]] a likely explanation is that [[L'ura]] is drawing them there like [[D'ore]] and [[K'ure]] drew spirits to [[Auchindoun]] and [[Oshu'gun]], respectively. ==Gallery== Mac'Aree concept.jpg|Concept art of Eredath overlooking Argus.
